correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and two distinct continuously absorbing sites with gamma0,gammad>0, norm derivative is minus 2 gamma0|psi0|^2+2 gammad|psid|^2. Nondecaying spectral subspace is exactly H-eigenvectors null at both traps; its orthogonal complement decays. Flux-dependent plane waves have simple energies unless 2alpha integral. At alpha=0 pair k,n-k yields sine dark modes when n divides 2kd; count floor((g-1)/2), g=gcd(n,2d), and finite sine-square sums give g/(2n) at g∤2j. At alpha=.5 shifted odd Fourier pairs yield n|d(2k+1), h=gcd(n,d), n/h odd, with odd-h and even-h sine sums giving the declared 0,h/(2n),h/n plateaus. n/h even and generic flux give zero. This establishes rate independence, source-resolved survival and m/(n-2) average. Independently built n-cycle magnetic matrices and computed trap-null spectral projectors for every n=3..20, every d, and alpha=0,.5,.137; compared exact dimensions and diagonals. Corrected numerical singular-space tolerance without changing mathematics.
